result:
Round 247 is implemented. When a history step removes a group row that has focus, focus now goes to the next row's name button (Music in the demo) instead of falling to BODY. Every check I ran matched B's expectations, and there was no STOP.

**Changed files** (exactly the grants; nothing committed or pushed):
- `ArrangementGroupHeader.tsx`, `StudioWorkspace.tsx` and `track-group-collapse-ui.test.tsx`: B's pre-checked diff applied unchanged. The diff equals B's file hunk for hunk.
- The task text says StudioWorkspace gets 42 added lines; the diff it grants actually adds 46. Only the count in the task is wrong.
- New `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/190-group-undo-focus.md`. Its status line is `Completed (C round 247 PASS)` byte for byte, and the 7 template headings are in order.
- The frozen-file and root-file hash checks give rc 0, and the 7 protected files are unchanged.

**Checks run:**
- **Static:** `npm run typecheck` rc 0, Biome clean on the 3 files, `npm run lint` rc 0.
- **Covering set:** 96/96 files, 1,492/1,492 tests, GF1–GF7 included.
  - The slowest test is CP12b at 5.1 s against its 30 s limit (7.2 s in gate 246). Nothing is near 50 % of its timeout.
- **Mutants:** all 9 runs gave exactly the red rows B listed. They ran on a copy outside the repo, and `git status` was identical before and after.
- **Browser** (Playwright on `:5173`, 1440×900 and 1280×720, 0 page errors):
  - Every row matches B's "Scratch fix" column. Focus lands on Music, or on the Group 1 name for nestedOuterUndo; it is never BODY.
  - The Tab case shows the brass 1 px ring.
  - The precedence, no-steal and keep-focus controls behave the same as at HEAD.
  - One row (groupUndo at 1440) timed out on page load while the mutants were loading the machine. I re-ran it once on its own and it passed.
- **Extra browser check:** I also checked the third `Ctrl+Z` of the group-volume row (C-VOLUME-REMOVAL-247). It lands on Music at both viewports. My script did not capture the Undo/Redo button titles, so C still needs to check those.

**Code review:** I ran the code-reviewer agent. It scored the change 8.5/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings. The fix is limited to B's exact hunks, so I did not change the code and passed these to B:
- **A-R247-REVIEW-L1:** if the removed row is not found in the stored order, focus would go to the first row. That can't happen today.
- **A-R247-REVIEW-L2:** the rescue doesn't check whether focus already moved in the same commit.
- **A-R247-REVIEW-L3:** the "previous row" fallback has no test; group history steps can't reach it.
- **Architecture note:** StudioWorkspace now has several separate focus-rescue mechanisms, ordered only by where they are declared. Keep them for now; a later merge is already filed as D-29z416.

I added two of the reviewer's points to doc 190: solo has no separate test, and neither does the fallback.

**Not claimed (left for C or the gate):** the screen-text budget row, the lab smoke and export hash, the auth checks, the marker regression row, the Undo/Redo titles above, C's independent review of doc 190, and the full suite, build, `npm run verify` and e2e smoke. The purchased-route row is BLOCKED because the backend is unavailable in the cloud.

The report, logs, probe output and screenshots are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; open `a-round-247.md` first.
